findings.observation: Канонический link-check намеренно пропускает относительные цели .png/.svg, а mkdocs --strict понижает missing-file до info, поэтому битые image-ссылки не валят ни check-links, ни strict build.
findings.method: static inspection of check_broken_links and mkdocs.yml validation.links; no live check-links run
findings.expected: File-level integrity for published image targets is enforced by python -m scripts.docs check-links and/or mkdocs build --strict, as claimed in mkdocs.yml comments.
findings.actual: check_broken_links continues on raw_target.endswith(('.png', '.svg')); mkdocs validation.links.not_found is info so --strict does not fail missing files. Comment in mkdocs.yml incorrectly attributes file-level integrity to check-links.
findings.impact: Published pages can ship broken diagram/image links while CI reports green. Generator/build exit 0 is not semantic correctness for visuals.
findings.root_cause: Temporary-missing PNG/SVG during local/CI render was handled by disabling file-not-found in both MkDocs and check-links instead of scoping the exemption to untracked png/ trees.
findings.remediation: Stop skipping .svg (tracked) in check_broken_links; keep PNG exemption only for gitignored **/png/**. Raise mkdocs not_found at least for non-png targets, or add an explicit image-existence runner in check-links and assert it in tests/architecture/test_check_doc_links_guardrails.py.

evidence.observation: if raw_target.endswith(('.png', '.svg')): continue
validation.links.not_found: info; comment claims check-links enforces file-level integrity

findings.observation: Каноническая команда python -m scripts.docs verify не включает passports check и check-drift --ai-surfaces, хотя оба есть в toolchain и CI/доках как отдельные обязательные шаги.
findings.method: read verify.py step list vs docs.yml jobs, TOOLS.md, and check_drift._run_checks
findings.expected: The documented one-command path matches the CI docs gate: links, drift (including ai-surfaces), passports, cleanup inventory, strict build.
findings.actual: verify runs check-links, check-drift --ports --classes --runtime-mirrors --freshness --modules, check-docstrings, cleanup-inventory --check, mkdocs --strict. It never calls scripts.docs passports check or --ai-surfaces. Passports live only in docs-governance; --ai-surfaces is only reachable via unflagged check-drift or an explicit flag that verify does not pass (so run_all is false and ai-surfaces is skipped).
findings.impact: Local/CI 'verify' green is not the full docs chain. Operators following docs/03-guides/docs-verification.md can miss passport drift and AI-surface policy regressions.
findings.root_cause: verify was assembled as a subset; later gates (passports, ai-surfaces) were added beside it rather than into it.
findings.remediation: Add passports check and --ai-surfaces to verify.py (with skip flags). Keep docs.yml passports step or collapse it into verify to avoid duplication.
findings.automation: unit test of verify step argv; docs.yml already has passports check

findings.observation: Shell-транспорт build_docs_site.sh берёт первый python/python3, у которого import mkdocs успешен, и не знает про .venv-win; это скрытое developer-local состояние относительно uv --frozen.
findings.method: read build_docs_site.sh and compare with CI uv run --frozen and agent-memory Windows .venv-win rule
findings.expected: Local docs build uses the pinned project interpreter (uv / .venv / .venv-win) so output matches CI.
findings.actual: Priority is: PATH python with mkdocs, else python3 with mkdocs, else .venv/bin/python, else Windows .venv via cmd.exe. A stray system MkDocs wins over the lockfile. .venv-win is never probed.

findings.root_cause: Compatibility adapter prefers any MkDocs-capable interpreter over the project extra.
findings.remediation: Resolve interpreter via scripts/engineering/dev/run_project_python.py (or uv run --frozen) and probe .venv-win on Windows before PATH python. Or deprecate the shell adapter in README in favor of python -m scripts.docs build-site only.

findings.observation: verify вызывает python -m mkdocs build напрямую, минуя канонический scripts.docs build-site (staging в docs/site, cleanup legacy site/).

findings.observation: check-drift завершается 0 при любом числе WARNING; в verify это означает, что предупреждения дрейфа (например ports facade re-export) не блокируют docs pipeline.
findings.method: read DriftReport.error_count vs warning_count and main() return; sample WARNING adds in check_ports/check_classes
findings.expected: Documented failure semantics: either warnings are non-blocking by design and listed, or verify treats WARNING as fail.
findings.actual: main returns 1 only if report.error_count. WARNING issues are printed but PASS. Examples: missing domain-layer doc is WARNING; port not re-exported in facade is WARNING.
findings.impact: Partial drift can accumulate without failing python -m scripts.docs verify or weekly --runtime-mirrors (runtime-mirrors themselves are ERROR).
findings.root_cause: Two-level severity without a --fail-on-warning switch in the verify chain.
findings.remediation: Document that WARNING is informational, or add --fail-on-warning for verify/CI. Do not raise debt budgets.

evidence.observation: return 1 if report.error_count else 0
Port exists but not re-exported in ports facade is WARNING
